entries.title: Hotline Miami
entries.definitive_edition: Hotline Miami on Windows PC, plus PlayStation bonus-mask check if documenting extras

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for the full playthrough; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best main archive route because it is the original release platform, has the current PC storefront route through Steam/GOG, and is the cleanest capture target. The PlayStation ports have a sourced bonus mask and leaderboards, so they are secondary-only for that extra content rather than the full run.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Hotline Miami on Steam or GOG for Windows PC for the main run; if documenting every extra, also sample a PlayStation release for the bonus mask/leaderboard route.

secondary.exclusive_content: PlayStation ports added a bonus mask and leaderboards.
secondary.what_to_play: Boot a PlayStation release only to document the bonus mask/leaderboard feature.
secondary.why: This is a small platform-specific extra, not enough to replace the Windows PC main run.

entries.remaster_caveats: Hotline Miami Collection improves availability on later consoles but does not replace the PC main run for archive capture.

entries.title: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number
entries.definitive_edition: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC pixel-art presentation with editor/Workshop access.

primary.version: Current PC release with level editor and Steam Workshop support
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it keeps the full sequel, the PC capture path, and the computer/Steam level editor and Workshop support. Later console collection ports are convenient, but they are not the completeness target for creator-made levels.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number on Steam for Windows PC and use the current build; use the level editor and Steam Workshop if documenting post-release user-created content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Hotline Miami Collection bundles both games on later consoles, but the PC version remains the best archival target for the sequel because of editor/Workshop support.
